The '''Mission to Metalorn''' occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was sent to [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] to stop the production of [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droids]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He succeeded in destroying the factory that produced them and captured the Separatist leader [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]].<ref name="NDA">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref>

==Prelude==
After repelling an [[Coruscant Insurrection|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Anakin Skywalker was sent to Metalorn to capture Wat Tambor and end the threat of the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droids]].<ref name="NDA" />

==The battle==
After landing on the planet, Anakin infiltrated the facility and found out the Separatists weren't just manufacturing a few of these new droids, but building an entire new droid army. After reporting this, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] ordered Anakin to destroy the facility. While searching for Tambor, Anakin was confronted by two [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]]: the brothers [[Vinoc]] and [[Karoc]]. After defeating them in a lightsaber duel, Anakin eventually reached the factory power core. He planted a series of bombs and then continued his search for Tambor. He eventually found him, and after defeating his [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] bodyguard [[Vandalor]], captured him. He then made it out of the facility before it blew.<ref name="NDA" />

But as he escorted Tambor back to his ship, Anakin was confronted by a [[Doppelgänger of Dooku|doppelgänger]] of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The two proceeded to duel. While it was evenly matched for a while, the doppelgänger began taunting Anakin with knowledge of [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|his mother]]. Anakin struck the doppelgänger down in anger, and brought Tambor back to Coruscant.<ref name="NDA" />

===Aftermath===
[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had Tambor placed under the watch of his personal guards when Anakin returned with him. Anakin reported the results of his mission to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who were pleased with how the mission turned out.<ref name="NDA" />
